label: TP
reason: The CodeQL finding indicates a potential command-line injection vulnerability. The user-provided input from getQueryString() is used directly in constructing the command arguments passed to Runtime.exec(), which can lead to arbitrary command execution if not properly sanitized.

evidence.note: User-provided input from getQueryString() is processed and used in constructing the command arguments.
The processed user input is included in the command arguments passed to Runtime.exec(), creating a potential command injection vector.
